movelist.name: Bug Buzz
movelist.range: Cone 2 or Close Blast 2, Sonic, Smite
movelist.effect: Bug Buzz lowers the Special Defense of all targets on 19+.

movelist.name: Guillotine
movelist.effect: Roll 1d100. This roll may not be modified in any way.  If you roll X or lower, the target Faints. X is equal to 30 + The User’s Level - The Target’s Level.

movelist.name: Acrobatics
movelist.effect: If the user is not holding an item, Acrobatics instead has a Damage Base of 11 (3d10+10 / 27).

movelist.name: Bug Bite
movelist.effect: If the target has a stored Digestion Buff or has traded in a Digestion Buff this Scene, the user may gain the effects of the Digestion Buff. This does not count towards the usual limit on the user’s Digestion Buffs.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.effect: The user gains Last Chance with Bug.

abilities.name: Rocket
abilities.effect: The user may take their turn at the top of the round. Priority, Interrupt, or Reaction Moves or Abilities cannot be declared in response to the user’s turn.
